mechanism_claims.claim_text: StpU and StpK increase S. aureus RN4220 membrane permeability in propidium iodide uptake assays at MIC and half-MIC, with two-fold fluorescence increases reported within tens of minutes at MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact fluorescence time-series values are plotted in Fig. 5 and not tabulated locally; qualitative/timing claims are retained from source text only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: StpU and StpK depolarize S. aureus RN4220 membranes in DiSC3(5) assays at half-MIC, MIC, and two-fold MIC; the source text reports delayed two-fold fluorescence increases at MIC for StpK and StpU.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The record does not infer a specific molecular pore structure; it preserves the assay-supported membrane depolarization/permeability phenotype.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GluA and GluC primarily cause membrane depolarization of S. aureus RN4220 in DiSC3(5) assays; PI uptake results showed less than a two-fold increase after 60 min, so major membrane-lesion activity is not overclaimed.
